Implemented Handlebars template support:

- `templates/*.hbs` page templates, selected via frontmatter `template`
- `templates/layouts/*.hbs` layouts using `{{{body}}}`
- `templates/partials/*.hbs` partials via `{{> name}}`
- Defaults to `default.hbs` and `layouts/default.hbs` when available
- Preserves existing built-in rendering if no templates exist
- Added `--templates <dir>` CLI option
- Added template/layout/partial coverage
